html:
Brooklyn-born, locally roasted, and very serious about good coffee. Meet Brooklyn Roasting Company — one of our favorite neighborhood spots for starting the day.

Brooklyn Roasting Company has been keeping the borough caffeinated since 2009, roasting its coffee right here in Brooklyn and serving it across three neighborhood cafés.

From 6am coffee runs to slow weekend mornings, here’s the BUZZY guide to Brooklyn Roasting Company: where to find them, when to go, and what to order.

Born & Roasted in Brooklyn

Brooklyn Roasting Company got its start in Williamsburg in 2009 with a pretty simple idea: source great coffee, roast it well, and serve it without the attitude.

The company describes itself much like the borough it calls home — bold, colorful, creative and always changing. Even its logo is a nod to Brooklyn: the outline stays the same while what happens inside it keeps evolving.

Today, BRC roasts out of Building 123 in the Brooklyn Navy Yard, a former industrial power plant built in 1899. With 60-foot ceilings, massive brick walls and a spot right on the East River, it’s a fittingly Brooklyn home base.

Sustainability has also been part of the operation from the beginning. BRC uses fuel-efficient roasting equipment, recyclable delivery totes and steel coffee cans, and the majority of the coffee it sources is Fair Trade certified.


Find Your Neighborhood BRC

Flushing Avenue — Brooklyn Navy Yard

200 Flushing Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11205

This is where the roasting happens. BRC’s café and production headquarters share the same historic Navy Yard building, so your morning coffee doesn’t have a particularly long commute.

It’s also the move for early risers: Flushing Avenue opens at 6am Monday through Friday.

One Clinton — Brooklyn Heights

1 Clinton St, Brooklyn, NY 11201

Sitting at the meeting point of Brooklyn Heights, Cobble Hill and Downtown Brooklyn, One Clinton is an easy stop before a walk through the neighborhood, a library visit, or whatever else your morning has in store.

The café shares the One Clinton building with the Brooklyn Public Library’s Brooklyn Heights branch, making it particularly well suited to the coffee + book combination.

Metropolitan Avenue — Williamsburg

543 Metropolitan Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11211

Back where it all started.

BRC was founded in Williamsburg in 2009, and its Metropolitan Avenue café keeps the company connected to its original neighborhood — right in the middle of one of Brooklyn’s best areas for wandering around with a coffee in hand.

Planning the coffee run? Here’s the current schedule:

Hours can change, so it’s always worth checking before you head out.

Okay, But What Are We Ordering?

The menu starts with coffee roasted at BRC’s Navy Yard headquarters, from dependable house blends to single-origin beans that rotate through different growing regions.

A few places to start:

  • Iris Espresso + BQE Espresso —
    BRC’s signature espresso blends and an easy introduction to the roaster.
  • Single-origin coffees — look for beans from Colombia, Ethiopia, Peru, Brazil, Guatemala and Sumatra.
  • Cold Brew — for the iced-coffee-in-any-weather crowd.
  • Oat Milk Latte — classic, spiced chai or mocha.
  • Peruvian Decaf — because sometimes you want another coffee without committing to another coffee.
  • Seasonal Selects — rotating coffees for anyone who likes letting the roaster choose.

You can also grab bags of beans to take home or sign up for BRC’s rotating coffee subscription.


Why They’re a BUZZY Bestie

Brooklyn Roasting Company feels distinctly Brooklyn because it actually is Brooklyn.

It was founded here. It roasts here. Its cafés are woven into their neighborhoods. And after more than 15 years — including a few seriously difficult ones — it’s still doing its thing a few miles from where it started.

That’s the kind of neighbor we like.

This Week at BUZZY: Free Brooklyn Roasting Cold Brew ☀️

We’re celebrating one of our favorite Brooklyn neighbors the best way we know how: with free coffee.

This week Monday 8/17 – Friday 8/21, stop by BUZZY in the morning and grab a free Brooklyn Roasting Company cold brew — no purchase necessary. We open at 8am, so whether you’re heading to work, walking the dog, or just getting an early start, come say hi and get caffeinated on us.

It’s part of BUZZY’s Besties, our way of showing some love to the local businesses that make Brooklyn feel like Brooklyn.

Good neighbors. Good coffee. Better mornings.
